summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only)  I traced the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus the session/cookie code in `modules/auth/handlers.ts` and `db/auth.ts` — and it's wired correctly end to end:  - Client fetches/saves only via the API (`credentials: "include"`), no localStorage/anonymous fallback. - Every watchlist route requires a valid session and scopes every query by `watchlists.user_id` (schema `.notNull()`, all reads/write
